result.title: PTGPO: Prefix Tree Group Policy Optimization
result.summary: Training language agents on long-horizon interactive tasks is challenging because sparse terminal rewards provide weak credit signals for intermediate actions. Existing group-based methods either assign a shared trajectory-level advantage or estimate step-level advantages from state groups, which may conflate the current action with subsequent decisions. We propose Prefix Tree Group Policy Optimization (PTGPO), a critic-free method that constructs prefix trees over trajectory suffixes within anchor-state groups. PTGPO assigns each tree edge a credit given by the difference between its child and parent empirical mean returns, capturing the conditional return change revealed by each additional action. These prefix-tree credits provide fine-grained learning signals without requiring a critic or additional rollouts. Experiments on interactive benchmarks ALFWorld, WebShop and Sokoban show that PTGPO consistently improves over RL baselines, demonstrating its effectiveness.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 PTGPO：一种无需 critic 的组策略优化方法，在 anchor-state 组内对轨迹后缀构建前缀树，以每个树边父子经验回报均值之差作为信用，为长程交互任务提供细粒度学习信号，并在 ALFWorld、WebShop、Sokoban 上超过 RL 基线。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「边级条件回报差分」为 LVR 中隐式中间推理步骤的贡献分配与轨迹监督提供了可供核查的方法线索，但实验限于纯文本交互 agent，是否可迁移到视觉 latent 状态与多模态推理步骤尚需人工判断。
